changesSince.base: CityMETER Luxury Brands 0.5 (same camera, basemap, massing, venue x-ray, pictogram and handoff contracts)
new: administrative areas (แขวง/ตำบล, เขต/อำเภอ) from production instead of self-defined neighborhoods
categorical cue symbols on the map
provenance line in every panel view
release020: venue candidates also from the END of the restaurant name (sheet names/aliases) and from repeated place endings within 200 m (name-derived places RX-…)
display-time spatial join of restaurant points to the drawn buildings (จุดตกในอาคาร)
venue buildings drawn and clickable in the area view; every focus building is a click target
area-hit at every zoom, neighbour labels at visible anchors, context dots no longer click targets

venueRows.definition: scopeRows whose name refers to the open venue (venue mode, or a store naming a hosted venue)

buildingRows.definition: scopeRows whose display point falls inside the open building's footprint (building mode, js/building-join.js#containsPoint); recomputed when the filters change

firstAha.denominator: sum of the three areas' production km² (Σrows ÷ Σkm², never an average of ratios)
firstAha.baseline: rows in the selection ÷ km² of the covered frames (≥ 1 row in the full dataset) inside the province/district filter
firstAha.secondaryFinding: area with the most reviews in the selection (popularity proxy, rows with a review count only)

firstAha.explicitAction: โฟกัส {areaCount} {แขวง|ตำบล}นี้ (when focus mode is none)

areas.classes: 5 equal-interval classes over (0, top] with top = max rounded up at the label precision (integers ≥ 20, one decimal ≥ 2, two decimals below); [lower, upper) with the last closed

eligibility.rationale: a density on a handful of rows is not a finding (random error ≈ 1/√n)

metricContract.popularity: reviews = Σ rating_count of rows that state it; rating mean over rated rows only; both are popularity proxies, not sales

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else quiet (carried over from Luxury Brands, owner 2026-10-22)

overviewAuto.focus: top-3 แขวง: density fill, ink label chips with value and class swatch, cue symbols, rounded focus massing (zoom ≥ 13)
overviewAuto.quiet: other frames outline-only with light label chips (≤ 12 on desktop, none on a phone); rows outside focus are grey context dots; city massing quiet

overviewAll.focus: every frame filled by density class; up to 30 labels (10 on a phone)

district.focus: the district's แขวง/ตำบล filled, district outline selected, their labels

area.focus: selected frame fill below zoom 14.5, selected outline, cue symbols, HTML pins and logos from zoom 15.5; buildings of the venues named by the focused rows in map.activeLayer (official host geometry, or joined OSM buildings) — every focus building is clickable
area.quiet: other frames outline-only with label chips at a visible point for every frame on screen (≤ 16 desktop, ≤ 4 phone) so the next แขวง/ตำบล is one click away

store.focus: selected ring, leader line to the source display position, desktop popup

venue.focus: only rows naming the venue carry detail; the focus massing follows the venue's surroundings (venueRegion); host building(s) in map.activeLayer drawn by the venue x-ray (always visible, clickable) and มุมสถาปนิก by default when a host building exists, otherwise the joined OSM buildings in the massing venue tier

building.focus: the clicked building in map.activeLayer and the rows whose points fall inside it
building.quiet: everything else; the camera stays where the user clicked

mapFocusContract.choropleth: density.area classes, opacity 1 beneath the basemap's first line layer, hard switch off at zoom ≥ 14.5, EVID-05 states per coverageContract
mapFocusContract.symbols: symbol layer of cue icons for focus rows above a grey circle layer of the whole scope (context: not focusable, not clickable, sent only when the filters change; first draw of > 5,000 rows deferred 0.9 s)
mapFocusContract.labels: HTML chips collision-managed against each other and the map chrome (sizes measured once); area labels from zoom 11.5, province labels below zoom 9; while navigating, every frame on screen gets a chip at its label point or the nearest visible grid point inside it (refreshLabelView on moveend)

venueMatchContract.rule: meta.venueRule; per row venueMatch: sheet | suffix | auto (null without a venue)
steps: for rows without one: a sheet venue name/alias at the END of the restaurant name; floor, zone, branch or terminal words may follow; alias unambiguous, not a generic chain word, ≥ 6 characters (or qsncc / มสธ)

a place-like ending (ตลาด…, อาคาร…, …Tower, …Avenue, …Market …) repeated on ≥ 2 names whose points all lie within 200 m of their median point (trimmed to a fixed point) → name-derived venue RX-<sha256(key)[:16]>, match 'auto'
venueMatchContract.exclusions: a place word after หน้า/ข้าง/ตรงข้าม/ใกล้/หลัง/ติด/เยื้อง/near/opposite/behind/next to/in front of/across … names a neighbour, never a host (41 rows in the snapshot)

copy.suffix: ชื่อร้านลงท้ายด้วยชื่อสถานที่นี้
copy.auto: ชื่อร้านลงท้ายด้วยชื่อนี้ · สถานที่จากชื่อร้าน

buildingJoinContract.decision: owner 2026-10-23: spatial join of restaurant names/venues with the 3D building mass
buildingJoinContract.buildings: focus-tier OSM footprints kept by js/massing.js before rounding/offset (stable ids focusFeatureId(tile, featureIndex, polygonIndex)) + official host buildings drawn by js/buildings.js
buildingJoinContract.points: row display positions (MVT z10 grid, ≈ 9.55 m)
buildingJoinContract.rule: a row joins the smallest drawn footprint containing its display point (holes excluded); bbox grid index; recomputed when the focus tier, the drawn hosts or the filters change
buildingJoinContract.venueBuildings: official host geometry when drawn; otherwise OSM buildings holding ≥ max(1, ⌈0.2 × n⌉) of the venue's n joined name-linked points

click.venue: the building is a venue's on screen → venue panel (the venue with most own points there)
click.building: several points, no venue → building panel ร้านที่จุดตกในอาคารนี้

buildingJoinContract.copy: จุดตกในอาคาร (never ตั้งอยู่ใน) + precision ≈ 9.55 m; venue panel lists ร้านอื่นที่จุดตกในอาคารเดียวกัน apart from the venue's own rows
neverChanges: any number outside the building and venue panels
buildingJoinContract.module: js/building-join.js (joinRows, venueBuildings, buildingVenues, resolveBuilding, venueNeighbours, venueRegion) + js/app.js#refreshJoin/applyJoin

clickOrder: official host building (any venue with rows in scope)
แขวง/ตำบล via area-hit at every zoom ≥ 8.5
interactionContract.sameArea: a click inside the selected area changes nothing (pan and tilt freely)
interactionContract.contextDots: never click targets: a click in the quiet context selects the area underneath
interactionContract.hover: pointer over anything clickable; a thin map.selectedStroke outline on the area a click would open
smoothMoves: update() reuses scopeRows and the area model while the filters are unchanged
pins re-send only the focus rows; the context (whole scope) is re-sent only on filter change
the focus massing is shaped after the camera stops (map.isMoving)
HTML pins keep their slots and only follow the map during a move; full layout on moveend

basemapContract.generator: js/map-style.js#buildMapStyle(theme, {palette, tileJSON, glyphs}) — a MapLibre style v8 object built at runtime; no hosted style URL

tiles.buildingLayer: building (fields render_height, render_min_height, hide_3d; available z13–14)
tiles.labels: name:th preferred, then name; no POI, housenumber or boundary labels

palette.source: assets/theme.css --basemap-* tokens (light and dark declared once each; basemap-only, not data colours)

layerOrder: massing + host buildings (inserted before MASSING_BEFORE = water-name, the first symbol layer)
area outlines, selection outline, pins, logos
basemapContract.atmosphere: sky + fog blend the far ground into the paper colour; viewport-anchored light (#FFFFFF, intensity 0.32) gives massing a soft shade; both are quiet context, never data
basemapContract.themeSwitch: map.setStyle(buildMapStyle(theme)) then re-install spatial layers; data layers keep the same HEX on both themes

massingContract.module: js/massing.js#installMassing(map, {sourceId, beforeId, colors, tileUrl, fetchImpl}) → {update, retheme, dispose, layerIds}

cityTier.layer: city-massing (fill-extrusion, source openmaptiles, source-layer building, minzoom 13)
cityTier.height: render_height / render_min_height from the tile; hide_3d features excluded
cityTier.filter: ['all', ['!=', ['get','hide_3d'], true], ['!', ['in', ['id'], ['literal', hiddenIds]]]] — OSM twins of host buildings hidden by feature id

focusTier.source: focus-massing (GeoJSON built from the same tile URLs MapLibre loads, decoded by js/mvt.js; z14, ≤ 9 tiles per update, tiles touching the focus regions only)
focusTier.selection: buildings overlapping a focus polygon (point-in-ring or ring intersection), clipped to the tile box with buffer, host-overlapping buildings dropped
focusTier.shape: js/geometry.js: cleanRing → clipRingToBox → offsetRing(+d) → roundRing(r, 3 segments, encloseOffset d)
focusTier.visibility: 3D and plan (plan shows the rounded footprints flat)
focusTier.cacheKey: regions + hosts + zoom bucket (full zoom level) + tile availability

hostTier.visibility: extrusion zoom ≥ 14, outline zoom ≥ 12, rows in focus only; before MASSING_BEFORE

rounding.radiusMetres: roundingRadiusM(zoom, lat) = clamp(4 px in metres at max(zoom, 14.5), 3, 12)
rounding.reference: maplibre/maplibre-style-spec#1047 (polygon corner radius) is unsupported in MapLibre; rounding is done in geometry, display only

enclosure.radiusCap: radius ≤ 0.95 · d / (1 − sin(θ/2)) so the rounded ring still encloses the original polygon at every corner
enclosure.purpose: the quiet city twin stays fully inside the rounded focus solid → no z-fighting without hiding it; host twins are hidden instead because the host solid is the data layer

massingContract.provenance: building heights and footprints are OSM via OpenFreeMap (defaults when no height tag); context only, never a claim of this dataset; OpenFreeMap merges same-height buildings into MultiPolygons, so single roofs cannot be picked

scene.occluderLayer: focus-massing-occluding (same source as the focus tier; filter by unique feature ids; the focus tier excludes them)
scene.occlusionTest: screen-space: a focus building whose box (ground vertices + tops lifted by height × local px/m × sin(pitch)) overlaps a target's box and whose mean ground y is larger (nearer the camera) is an occluder; recomputed on moveend and after each tile update; targets = the venue's host rings (buildings.js displayedFeatures filtered by mall_ids / venue_names) with display_height_m

distanceFade.rule: city-tier colour interpolates from --basemap-massing-quiet (fade 0) to --basemap-ground (fade 1, invisible) by distance from the nearest focus anchor (area centroid; every area when nothing is focused)
distanceFade.mechanism: feature-state `fade` written once per building id after tiles load (querySourceFeatures on sourcedata/moveend); anchors change → states rebuilt
distanceFade.why: MapLibre has no camera-distance expression and fill-extrusion-opacity is not data-driven

cameraContract.module: js/camera.js (CAMERA, presetFor, applyPreset, fitPitched, framePoint, shiftPadding)

plan.when: view3d off (3D toggle / ?view3d=0) or bounds wider than 0.3°

model.when: แขวง/ตำบล in 3D (and venue level when มุมสถาปนิก is switched off) — near-axonometric, verticals upright

eye.when: venue level only (venue mode, or a store inside a venue): on by default, ?cam=model opts out; disabled elsewhere and in 2D; on mobile portrait it waits until the sheet closes
eye.constraint: MapLibre 5.6.2 draws fill-extrusion displaced or not at all once the horizon enters the viewport (pitch > 90 − fov/2) — verified live 2026-10-22 (pitch 73 ok, 76 displaced, 82 missing); the eye preset keeps the horizon just outside the frame (90 − 12 − 3 = 75)

fitting.function: fitPitched(map, bounds, {preset, padding, maxZoom 16, minZoom 10, points, shift})
fitting.method: start from cameraForBounds (flat), apply preset pitch/bearing/FOV, zoom out in 0.1 steps until every point (polygon vertices when given, else bbox corners) projects inside the padded viewport, then zoom in while they still fit; jumps are computed without rendering and the final camera is animated
fitting.padding: desktop 3D padding ignores the legend; mobile portrait with the sheet open uses plan, then re-frames in 3D on sheet close
fitting.bearing: 28° so the Siam → Chit Lom → Phrom Phong axis runs left-to-right on wide screens
fitting.venue: frameVenue: fitPitched over the host footprint vertices AND roof vertices (vertex + display_height_m, projected with camera.projectPoint through transform.modelViewProjectionMatrix), top padding 12% (eye) / 10% (model), maxZoom 17.6, minZoom = max(14.5, footprint-only fit − 1) so a very tall tower cannot push the pins out of reading range; falls back to framePoint(zoom 16) when no host building is displayed or on mobile portrait
fitting.แขวง/ตำบล: fitArea: fitPitched over the area outline vertices, maxZoom 17.5 so the outline fills the frame

maplibre.requires: setVerticalFieldOfView (≥ 4.7), maxPitch 85; keep pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3 for any fill-extrusion view
maplibre.orthographic: not available in MapLibre; narrow FOV is the standard substitute

cameraContract.alternatives: deck.gl custom projectionMatrix or three.js camera.setViewOffset give a true two-point camera; not adopted to keep a single MapLibre scene

productionPath.observed: https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{PROVINCE_CODE}[/D/{district code}|/S/{subdistrict code}]?d=restaurant (route scheme read from the production bundle, ViewMode D/S/M/L; HTTP 200 checked 2026-10-22)

provinceCodes.SPK: สมุทรปราการ
provinceCodes.CCO: ฉะเชิงเทรา

breadcrumbContract.folding: four levels fold the upper two behind “…” on narrow screens

panel.navigation: back stack (max 20); mode and id restored from URL (?district, ?area, ?place, ?store)
panel.renderer: js/panel.js (pure HTML strings, delegated data-action clicks); provenance() ends every view: ชุดข้อมูล · แหล่ง · ดึงข้อมูล · ขอบเขต + popularity caveat

data.observationGrain: one observation of the public CityMETER Restaurants overlay (owning-tile view); never merged by name or coordinate
data.core: data/restaurants.json (columnar; meta, priceBuckets, groups, types, typeGroup, areas, brands, venues, cols, brand, venue, venueEntity, venueMatch)
data.verification: fresh reproduction of the public API matched all 70,214 rows on every compared field (handoff/VERIFICATION.md)
data.coordinatePolicy: MVT display positions (z10, extent 4096, 9.55 m) stored as grid integers; decoded with the research formula; screen-space displacement only; precision described, never upgraded
data.membershipPolicy: source subdistrict code; no point-in-polygon on display positions; no name matching

visualSystem.appliedTokens: assets/theme.css (foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, dataState, series 1–10, count classes, basemap-only tokens)

analyticalScales.themePolicy: identical light HEX on both themes

locationProfile.reason: restaurant observations are not a supply-capacity, demand or market measure

visualSystem.reportedDifference: dark no-data/zero colours differ between the analytical scale records (#3B4849 / #BAC6C0) and machine.tokens.dataState (#404844 / #93A398); the EVID-05 treatments reference dataState, which the map uses

invariants.rule: One observation owns one symbol; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context dots
Membership is the source subdistrict code; never re-assign by point-in-polygon on display coordinates or by name
Density = rows ÷ production km²; combined density Σrows ÷ Σkm²; never average ratios
Never rank by density below MIN_AREA_ROWS (30); small selections switch to counts and say so
Missing is never zero: no rating, no price, no type and uncovered frames stay missing / no_data
no_data (uncovered frame) ≠ measured_zero (covered frame, 0 under the filter); hatch vs zero outline
Every panel view ends with dataset · source · date · boundary
Ratings and reviews are popularity proxies; never called sales, demand or quality

Chain and venue links are name-based candidates (sheet link, name ending, repeated place ending within 200 m): no “สาขา”, no “ตั้งอยู่ใน”, no proximity inference for membership; a place word after หน้า/ข้าง/near/behind is never a host
Coordinates are display positions; displacement is screen-space only; precision label kept
Analytical colours are exact LDS LUT values, identical on both themes; categorical colours keep their shape cue
The first paint is the 3D city preset with the auto focus; numbers never change with the camera
scopeRows drive the Aha, choropleth and charts; rows drive symbols with detail, counters and table
Province frames use counts, not density
Breadcrumb levels and deep links follow production codes; a venue never sits under a แขวง; a store is never a crumb
Logos keep original bytes (sha256), lookup by id only, ≤ 250 on screen, only at detail zoom inside the focus; holds have none

Only venue buildings carry the data colour (official host geometry or joined OSM buildings): in the area view for the venues named by the focused rows, at venue level only that venue's (official ones kept visible by the x-ray), in building mode only the open building
Matrix cells are equal in size; price shares are of priced rows only
Core value (Aha, panel, charts, table) works without the map
No private Drive/Sheet URLs, credentials, internal sheet or full LDS library in the repository
Map attribution (OpenStreetMap, OpenMapTiles/OpenFreeMap, CityMETER) stays readable above the charts tray; the legend, the phone Aha card and area labels keep clear of it
A measured non-zero density never prints as 0 (one shared format: 1 decimal ≥ 1, 2 decimals below 1, “<0.01” below that) on labels, panel and charts
A venue total says how many of its rows (and reviews) are the venue's own listing (e.g. the mall row); rows are kept as the source lists them
The building join is display-time only: display points × drawn footprints, said as “จุดตกในอาคาร” with the ≈ 9.55 m caveat; it never changes a venue's rows or counts or any area number
Map clicks follow interactionContract.clickOrder; another แขวง/ตำบล is clickable at every zoom; a click inside the selected area changes nothing; quiet context dots are never targets
A selection never re-sends the context points or shapes massing during a camera move; pins only follow the map while it moves

venueXrayContract.module: js/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, hitTest(point), dispose, count, enabled, failed}
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (type custom, renderingMode 3d), inserted before water-name after every fill-extrusion layer
venueXrayContract.input: host features of the venue being looked at (mall_ids / venue_names match) with render_as = extrusion; display_base_m / display_height_m
venueXrayContract.geometry: walls (two triangles per edge), roof via earcut (holes supported; js/vendor/earcut.js 3.2.4 ISC), edge lines; mercator coordinates relative to the centroid origin; z = MercatorCoordinate.z of the altitude

venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the venue screen box (device pixels, padded 4 px), then LEQUAL read-write depth test against itself only; polygon offset keeps edges on top
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only (pitch > 0) and zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); hidden with the 3D toggle; disabled at non-venue levels (empty feature set)
venueXrayContract.colours: faces map.activeLayer × shade (roof 1, walls 0.66–0.92 by orientation), edges map.selectedStroke — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.interaction: two paths: the style layer luxury-venue-buildings-3d (MapLibre hit-test, reliable near the footprint) and xray.hitTest(point) — point-in-triangle against the solid projected with the last frame matrix — wired in app.js on map click (opens the venue when not already there) and mousemove (pointer cursor); MapLibre alone misses tall walls away from the footprint (observed live 2026-10-22)
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables the layer (failed = true) and the style host layer keeps drawing
references: MapLibre src/render/draw_fill_extrusion.ts — translucent extrusions drawn depth-first, then colour with depth EQUAL
venueXrayContract.knownTradeOff: inside the cleared box a translucent 2D layer that sits below an opaque fill in style order may draw over it; none of the generated paper style layers are ordered that way

provinceContract.data: data/provinces.geojson — 7 provinces holding rows; id = production code (BKK …), code = DOPA two-digit; dissolved from the production subdistrict frames and simplified at 120 m (scripts/build-boundaries.py)
provinceContract.module: js/provinces.js#installProvinceLayers(map, geojson) → {update({rows, selectedCode, visible}), dispose, model}; buildProvinceModel(rows, geojson)
provinceContract.rows: filterRows(data.rows, {...filters, province: ''}) so each frame keeps its own count
provinceContract.metric: rows per province (count family, 5 equal-interval classes); measured_zero = lowest fill + zero outline; out_of_scope (70 provinces) not drawn
provinceContract.panel: overview list จังหวัดที่มีร้านในชุดข้อมูล (count, class swatch) — each a drill-down into the จังหวัด filter
